title: Shape Calculator
description:
```
Shapes, largest area first:
  Rectangle 4 x 5      area 20     perimeter 18
  Circle r=2           area 12.57  perimeter 12.57
  Triangle 3 4 5       area 6      perimeter 12
Total area: 38.57
```
hints: Sort pointers by what they point at: `std::sort(shapes.begin(), shapes.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) { return a->area() > b->area(); });`.
A triangle's area from its three sides is Heron's formula: with `s = (a + b + c) / 2`, the area is `std::sqrt(s * (s - a) * (s - b) * (s - c))`.
requirements: An abstract `Shape` with pure virtual `area()`, `perimeter()` and `name()`, and a virtual destructor
A `std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Shape>>` filled from what the user types
Sorted by area, largest first, with the total area
stretch: Should `Square` inherit from `Rectangle`? Write your answer in a comment (think about a `setWidth` function), then add `operator<<` through a private virtual `print`.
